tests: A description list where bold terms sit at the left margin with indented definitions, and two terms carry two definitions each.
attacks: Structure choice. The bold left-margin terms are strong candidates for promotion to headings, which would make each definition a section body and lose the term-definition pairing. Flattening to paragraphs loses which definition belongs to which term — and the second Spell definition explicitly contradicts the first, so a wrong pairing changes the meaning rather than merely degrading it.
title: Glossary of Reporting Terms

lists.note: A description list, not an unordered list and not a sequence of headings. Terms bind to the definitions beneath them.

intentionalProblems: bold terms that look like headings
two Spell definitions that contradict each other if mispaired
